'''2001 Missouri State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Missouri in 2001. [[Dustin Horn]] won it undefeated.<ref name="dt-15658">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15658 MO States Winning LS Deck - QMC Generals], DeckTech (Dustin "Norman" Horn, 30 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15658/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15658/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 30 April)
* '''Site:''' Missouri
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Dustin Horn]]

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Dustin Horn won Missouri States undefeated with a Light Quiet Mining Colony deck, beating Hunt Down three times, including the 2nd- and 3rd-place players. His brother [[Norman Horn]] posted the list on DeckTech for him.<ref name="dt-15658" /> Todd Vandewalker took 3rd at 2–1 with Light Hidden Base mains; his loss was to a My Kind Of Scum deck, and he notes the posted list differs slightly from what he played.<ref name="dt-15374" />
